title: Renewal *expiry ke din* yaad dilaya? 1 hafta late ho.
fix_label: Expiry se 7 din pehle ye bhejo 👇
message:
Hi [naam] 💪 aapki membership *[date]* ko khatam ho rahi hai.
Is mahine aapne [X] workouts kiye, consistency 🔥
Abhi renew karo to *[offer]*. Reply "YES", link bhej denge.
why: expiry se pehle decision aasaan hai. *Unka apna progress* dikhao, offer ki deadline do.
caption:
Gym member expiry ke din nahi chhodta. Woh 2 hafte pehle mann se chhod chuka hota hai. 🏋️

7 din pehle renewal message:
1️⃣ Expiry date
2️⃣ Unka khud ka progress (workouts / weight)
3️⃣ Early renewal offer
4️⃣ "YES" reply = link

3 din pehle trainer ka voice note. Save karo 🔖

📲 Ye problem aapke business mein bhi hai? WhatsApp karo: 98131 36114, hum set kar denge.
